purpose: Use source-blind AI-assisted preannotation to advance the semantic-surface relation study while preserving the untouched human-review templates for a later independent manual review.

roles.recovery_note: The first reviewer process stopped responding after one draft; that draft was preserved outside the merge root and a fresh source-blind reviewer restarted all twelve packets.

forbidden: original path or original image hash
pixel, provenance, watermark, camera or origin scores
inference or recording of real-versus-generated identity

review_independence.reason: Hidden duplicate agreement is meaningful only when repeated packets are judged independently.

output.label: AI-assisted blind preannotation, not human ground truth

merge_gates: all 36 reviewer IDs occur exactly once
every annotation validates against its blind review packet
every decided family maps each non-outlier member to one of its referenced semantic surfaces and every referenced surface contains a family member
all original human template SHA-256 values remain unchanged
no source or posthoc fields occur in agent annotation payloads

decision_rules.agent_annotation_success: May inform a relation-graph engineering proposal and a later human disagreement queue only.
decision_rules.agent_annotation_failure: Preserve outputs as diagnostic drafts; do not repair them with source labels.
decision_rules.human_ground_truth_claim: Forbidden until an independent human review is completed.
decision_rules.posthoc_source_analysis: Deferred; the source key stays closed in this phase.
